#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskF {
private:
    int n;
    string s;
    vector<int> beauty;
    int totalBeauty;
    vector<int> equalPairs;
    vector<int> charOccurrences;
    char mostCommonChar;

public:
    void solve() {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(NULL);

        cin >> n;
        cin >> s;
        beauty.resize(n);
        totalBeauty = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            cin >> beauty[i];
            totalBeauty += beauty[i];
        }

        equalPairs.clear();
        charOccurrences.assign(128, 0);
        mostCommonChar = 'a';
        int half = n / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
            if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                equalPairs.push_back(i);
                charOccurrences[s[i]]++;
                if (charOccurrences[s[i]] > charOccurrences[mostCommonChar]) {
                    mostCommonChar = s[i];
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = totalBeauty;
        for (int idx : equalPairs) {
            ans -= min(beauty[idx], beauty[n - 1 - idx]);
        }

        if (charOccurrences[mostCommonChar] > (int)equalPairs.size() / 2) {
            vector<int> penalties;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; ++j) {
                if (s[j] != s[n - 1 - j] && s[j] != mostCommonChar && s[n - 1 - j] != mostCommonChar) {
                    penalties.push_back(min(beauty[j], beauty[n - 1 - j]));
                }
            }
            sort(penalties.begin(), penalties.end());
            int rem = 2 * charOccurrences[mostCommonChar] - (int)equalPairs.size();
            for (int k = 0; k < rem; ++k) {
                ans -= penalties[k];
            }
        }

        cout << ans << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
